cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Pete Ross, and this edition is published in the later hours of Friday, the 14th of August.
cues.zh: 我是皮特·罗斯。本期节目于 8 月 14 日星期五深夜发布。

cues.en: Raised eyebrows in Britain as Benjamin Netanyahu calls the UK an “Islamic Republic of Great Britain”.
cues.zh: 本雅明·内塔尼亚胡称英国为“伊斯兰共和国大不列颠”，在英国引发哗然。

cues.en: In Japan, several people have died after unprecedented rainfall causes flooding and landslides, as the UN raises food-security fears if the extreme weather continues.
cues.zh: 日本遭遇前所未有的强降雨，引发洪水和山体滑坡，造成多人死亡；联合国警告，极端天气持续可能威胁粮食安全。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, the leader of Britain's right-wing Reform Party, Nigel Farage, is re-elected as an MP.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将关注：英国右翼改革党的领导人奈杰尔·法拉奇再次当选议员。

cues.en: In the middle of August, in holiday season, we have secured far more votes than we got in the general election of 2024!
cues.zh: 八月中旬正值假期，我们获得的选票远远超过 2024 年大选时的票数！

cues.en: But investigations into his finances go on.
cues.zh: 但对其财务状况的调查仍在继续。

cues.en: Relations between Israel and the UK have been strained for a while,
cues.zh: 以色列与英国的关系紧张已有一段时间，

cues.en: but the Israeli Prime Minister, Benjamin Netanyahu, appears to have risked making them worse still by suggesting Britain is now an “Islamic Republic of Great Britain”.
cues.zh: 但以色列总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡暗示英国如今是“伊斯兰共和国大不列颠”，似乎可能让关系进一步恶化。

cues.en: In a podcast with Israeli Army Radio, Mr Netanyahu recalled meeting the grandson of Winston Churchill, describing him as a lover of Israel,
cues.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在接受以色列军方电台播客采访时，回忆起与温斯顿·丘吉尔的孙子见面，并称他是以色列的热爱者，

cues.en: then remarking that you won't find that kind of attitude in the UK now, which he said was known as the “Islamic Republic of Great Britain”.
cues.zh: 随后他说，如今在英国找不到那种态度，而英国被称为“伊斯兰共和国大不列颠”。

cues.en: He'd been talking about how the Six-Day War in 1967 was reported on by Winston Churchill's son and grandson, both journalists at the time.
cues.zh: 他谈到 1967 年的六日战争如何被温斯顿·丘吉尔的儿子和孙子报道；两人当时都是记者。

cues.en: By the way, he and his father, Randolph Churchill, Churchill's son, came here and covered the Six-Day War here in a very positive way for us.
cues.zh: 顺便说一句，他和他的父亲兰道夫·丘吉尔——丘吉尔的儿子——来到这里报道六日战争，对我们给予了非常积极的报道。

cues.en: Try finding that in Britain now, in what is called the “Islamic Republic of Great Britain”.
cues.zh: 现在你可以试着在英国找到这种报道——这个被称为“伊斯兰共和国大不列颠”的地方。

cues.en: A spokesperson for the Israeli Prime Minister's office, David Mencer, said Mr Netanyahu was merely quoting the American Vice President, JD Vance.
cues.zh: 以色列总理办公室发言人大卫·门瑟说，内塔尼亚胡只是在引用美国副总统 J·D·万斯的话。

cues.en: He was making a quote that someone else had given.
cues.zh: 他引用的是别人说过的话。

cues.en: His words exactly were, “Someone had called it that.”
cues.zh: 他的原话是：“有人这样称呼它。”

cues.en: And when you look into it, it was actually Vice President JD Vance that made those comments at the Munich Security Summit, but also at a convention in 2024.
cues.zh: 但仔细查证后会发现，这些话其实是副总统 J·D·万斯在慕尼黑安全会议以及 2024 年一次大会上说的。

cues.en: So those are the words of the Vice President.
cues.zh: 所以那是副总统的话。

cues.en: I asked our correspondent in Jerusalem, Yolande Knell, what we should make of the comments.
cues.zh: 我询问了驻耶路撒冷记者约兰德·内尔，我们应如何看待这些言论。

cues.en: Well, he's speaking in a long podcast with a host on Israeli Army Radio, a man who lost his son in Gaza.
cues.zh: 嗯，他是在以色列军方电台的一档长篇播客中发表这些言论的，主持人是一名儿子在加沙丧生的男子。

cues.en: And you have to remember that the Israeli Prime Minister is currently in campaign mode, with these elections due at the end of October, and he's currently trailing in the polls.
cues.zh: 你必须记住，以色列总理目前正处于竞选状态，选举定于 10 月底举行，而他目前在民调中落后。

cues.en: Now, he recalled meeting the writer, grandson of Winston Churchill, also called Winston, whom he said had represented Israel in a very positive way.
cues.zh: 他回忆起与作家、温斯顿·丘吉尔的孙子——同样名叫温斯顿——见面；他说，对方曾以非常积极的方式代表以色列。

cues.en: Along with his father Randolph, before he went on to contrast that relationship with the UK today.
cues.zh: 他还提到对方的父亲兰道夫，随后将那段关系与今天的英国作了对比。

cues.en: And he said, “Try to find that now in Britain. You could of course call it the “Islamic Republic of Britain”,
cues.zh: 他说：“现在你可以试着在英国找到这种态度。当然，你可以把它称为‘伊斯兰共和国大不列颠’，

cues.en: and it could potentially be the first Islamic republic with nuclear weapons,” seemingly forgetting about the Islamic Republic of Pakistan.
cues.zh: 它可能成为第一个拥有核武器的伊斯兰共和国。”他似乎忘了巴基斯坦伊斯兰共和国。

cues.en: And it's really being read as, you know, underlining the deterioration, I guess, in relations between Israel and the UK.
cues.zh: 这些话确实被解读为强调以色列与英国关系的恶化。

cues.en: These are two countries that have historically been close allies.
cues.zh: 这两个国家历史上一直是亲密盟友。

cues.en: They cooperate diplomatically and on security matters, and a lot of that has been to do with Britain taking a more critical stance over Israel's conduct of the war in Gaza.
cues.zh: 两国在外交和安全事务上开展合作，而这种关系很大程度上与英国对以色列在加沙战争中的行为采取更批判的立场有关。

cues.en: And the Israeli government has repeatedly criticized the UK's Labour government since it moved to recognize a Palestinian state.
cues.zh: 自英国工党政府采取承认巴勒斯坦国的行动以来，以色列政府一直在反复批评该政府。

cues.en: Mr Netanyahu argues that such measures risk rewarding Hamas, but it's not just the UK.
cues.zh: 内塔尼亚胡认为，这类措施可能奖励哈马斯，但问题不只在英国。

cues.en: He's also saying that it's demographic changes across all of Europe, Muslims immigrating to Europe, that has led to increased criticism of Israel's policies.
cues.zh: 他还表示，是整个欧洲的人口结构变化、穆斯林移民欧洲，导致了对以色列政策的更多批评。

cues.en: When he's asked about Israel's increased isolation on the international stage, these comments were made in Hebrew.
cues.zh: 当被问及以色列在国际舞台上日益孤立时，他是在希伯来语中发表这些言论的。

cues.en: On an army podcast, it's clearly for an Israeli audience. Do you think he expected them to go more widespread than that, and if so, what should we make of it?
cues.zh: 这是在军方播客上发表的，显然面向以色列听众。你认为他预料到这些言论会传播得更广吗？如果是，我们该如何看待？

cues.en: Yes, certainly it was primarily for a domestic audience, and as I say, he's in campaign mode.
cues.zh: 是的，当然，这主要面向国内听众，而且正如我所说，他正处于竞选状态。

cues.en: But also, this is an important moment, isn't it? We've just got a new Prime Minister in the UK, Andy Burnham.
cues.zh: 但这也是一个重要时刻，不是吗？英国刚刚迎来新首相安迪·伯纳姆。

cues.en: He has been looking to recalibrate Labour's position on the Middle East.
cues.zh: 他一直在寻求重新调整工党在中东问题上的立场。

cues.en: He has apologised for the Labour Party's initial response to Israeli actions in Gaza,
cues.zh: 他为工党最初应对以色列在加沙行动的方式道歉，

cues.en: where the former Prime Minister was deemed to have been slow in calling for a ceasefire.
cues.zh: 此前首相被认为迟迟没有呼吁停火。

cues.en: He said that Labour must do better, and in a video message just last month, he said
cues.zh: 他说工党必须做得更好；在上个月的一段视频讲话中，他表示，

cues.en: that the UK should be clear in criticism of events in Gaza and simultaneously should condemn the Hamas-led attack on the 7th of October 2023,
cues.zh: 英国应明确批评加沙发生的事件，同时谴责哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击，

cues.en: antisemitism, that is, the different incidents that have been happening in the UK.
cues.zh: 以及反犹太主义，也就是英国发生的各种相关事件。

cues.en: So there's an expectation here that his government is going to take a harder line than perhaps the government that came before.
cues.zh: 因此，人们期待他的政府会比前任政府采取更强硬的立场。

cues.en: So I think Mr Netanyahu will see this as, you know, serving a dual purpose.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，内塔尼亚胡会把这些言论看作一举两得。

cues.en: You know, it will resonate with some of the Israeli public,
cues.zh: 它会引起部分以色列民众的共鸣，

cues.en: but also he does imagine that these remarks can of course be translated, especially nowadays in the media, and will be picked up by the UK.
cues.zh: 但他也确实认为，这些言论当然可以被翻译，尤其是在如今的媒体环境下，并会受到英国方面的关注。

cues.en: Yolande Knell in Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 约兰德·内尔在耶路撒冷报道。

cues.en: To Japan now, where record rainfall has caused flooding in the east of the country near Tokyo, leaving several people dead.
cues.zh: 现在转向日本：创纪录的降雨在东京附近的日本东部引发洪水，造成多人死亡。

cues.en: The Chiba Prefecture has had more than three times its average rainfall this month alone.
cues.zh: 千叶县仅本月的降雨量就超过平均水平的三倍。

cues.en: This comes after a series of storms swept through Japan and neighbouring countries in what forecasters say is an unusually active typhoon season.
cues.zh: 此前一系列风暴席卷日本及邻国，气象预报员称今年台风季异常活跃。

cues.en: Our Tokyo correspondent, Kurumi Mori, told me more.
cues.zh: 我们的东京记者森久留美告诉了我更多情况。

cues.en: We're seeing record rainfall in Chiba Prefecture. Now, that is a prefecture to the east of Tokyo. Japan's Weather Agency have declared that this is unprecedented.
cues.zh: 千叶县正出现创纪录的降雨。这是位于东京东部的一个县。日本气象厅宣布，这是前所未有的情况。

cues.en: Japan's Self-Defense Forces have been deployed to the area to help people who are trapped and stuck in flooded areas and get them to safety.
cues.zh: 日本自卫队已部署到当地，帮助被困在洪水区域的人们脱险并转移到安全地带。

cues.en: Authorities warn that more heavy rain is still possible, so they are cautioning people to stay alert.
cues.zh: 当局警告仍可能有更强降雨，因此提醒人们保持警惕。

cues.en: And Chiba Prefecture, which as you say is right next to the capital Tokyo, that must be a fairly heavily populated part of the country.
cues.zh: 千叶县正如你所说紧邻首都东京，那里一定是日本人口相当密集的地区。

cues.en: What has been the impact for people living there?
cues.zh: 当地居民受到了什么影响？

cues.en: Yeah, absolutely. I mean, there are a lot of commuters, you can imagine. So far, we're seeing more than 19,000 households still without power as of last check.
cues.zh: 是的，当然。你可以想象，那里有很多通勤者。截至上次核查，仍有超过 19,000 户家庭停电。

cues.en: About 100,000 to 400,000 people were ordered to evacuate last night at the peak.
cues.zh: 昨晚高峰时段，约有 100,000 至 400,000 人被下令疏散。

cues.en: Roads were submerged in water.
cues.zh: 道路被水淹没。

cues.en: I spoke to a Chiba resident who was telling me that they're seeing a bunch of abandoned cars left out on the roads because the roads are still flooded.
cues.zh: 我采访了一名千叶居民，他说由于道路仍被洪水淹没，路上有许多被遗弃的汽车。

cues.en: And also, the BBC, we just got off the phone with JMA, Japan's Weather Agency,
cues.zh: 此外，BBC 刚刚与日本气象厅通完电话，

cues.en: and they told us that the special warning has been lifted, but people are still urged to remain cautious because the atmospheric conditions remain unstable.
cues.zh: 对方告诉我们特别警报已经解除，但由于大气状况仍不稳定，人们仍被敦促保持谨慎。

cues.en: And just how unusual is this amount of rainfall in Japan?
cues.zh: 那么，这样的降雨量在日本有多罕见？

cues.en: Heavy summer rain isn't anything particularly new;
cues.zh: 夏季暴雨并不特别新鲜；

cues.en: it's more about how intense these downpours can become and how quickly they can overwhelm roads and infrastructure and the drainage systems.
cues.zh: 关键在于暴雨可能有多猛烈，以及它们能多快压垮道路、基础设施和排水系统。

cues.en: This week is a holiday in Japan. It's called Obon; that's when we traditionally travel back to our hometowns.
cues.zh: 本周是日本的节假日，叫作盂兰盆节；按照传统，人们会在这时返回家乡。

cues.en: So the storm is also having an impact there, with reports of travellers being stranded at Narita Airport; around 7,000 of them stranded.
cues.zh: 所以风暴也影响了出行，有报道称旅客滞留在成田机场，其中约 7,000 人被困。

cues.en: This is not the first of these types of storms that Japan has experienced in the last couple of weeks.
cues.zh: 这不是日本过去几周经历的第一场此类风暴。

cues.en: No, you know, we've been seeing quite an interesting variety of weather events, natural disasters.
cues.zh: 不，你知道，我们最近经历了各种有趣的天气事件和自然灾害。

cues.en: We had an earthquake in Kumamoto followed by quite a severe heatwave,
cues.zh: 熊本发生了地震，随后是相当严重的热浪，

cues.en: where we saw up to 18,000 people be hospitalized for heatstroke in just one week in late July, followed by this severe rainfall in Chiba Prefecture.
cues.zh: 7 月底短短一周内，多达 18,000 人因中暑住院，之后千叶县又遭遇了这场强降雨。

cues.en: And a short while ago, the government reported a volcanic eruption happening in Japan.
cues.zh: 不久前，日本政府还报告了火山喷发。

cues.en: We're getting everything on all sides when it comes to these extreme weather events and these natural disasters.
cues.zh: 面对这些极端天气事件和自然灾害，我们似乎各方面都遇到了。

cues.en: Kurumi Mori in Tokyo.
cues.zh: 森久留美在东京报道。

cues.en: From one weather event to another, the extreme heat ravaging much of Europe.
cues.zh: 从一种天气事件转向另一种：极端高温正在肆虐欧洲大部分地区。

cues.en: Temperatures have reached well above 40 degrees Celsius in some places, and that's prompted growing alarm about the damage being done to the planet and its inhabitants.
cues.zh: 一些地方的气温已远超 40 摄氏度，引发了人们对地球及其居民所受损害日益增长的担忧。

cues.en: Now the United Nations has added its voice to flag concerns about the pressure extreme weather events like drought are putting on food security.
cues.zh: 现在，联合国也发出警告，强调干旱等极端天气事件正给粮食安全带来压力。

cues.en: Kaveh Zahedi from the UN's Food and Agriculture Organization told my colleague Kassi Mdeira that the weather to come could make the problem even more pronounced.
cues.zh: 联合国粮食及农业组织的卡韦·扎赫迪告诉我的同事卡西·姆代拉，未来的天气可能让问题更加严重。

cues.en: We're concerned across the board because the combined impact of the droughts and the extreme heat that we're seeing is becoming essentially a serious threat to food security.
cues.zh: 我们对此全面感到担忧，因为目前旱灾和极端高温的叠加影响，实际上正成为对粮食安全的严重威胁。

cues.en: Of course, extreme heat, first and foremost, we see an impact on the staple crops, staple crops that feed the world.
cues.zh: 当然，极端高温首先影响的是主粮作物，也就是养活全世界的那些作物。

cues.en: We're talking about maize, rice, soy, wheat, some of the ones that you mentioned.
cues.zh: 我们说的是玉米、水稻、大豆和小麦，也包括你提到的其他作物。

cues.en: We know that for every 1-degree increase in average global temperatures, there's going to be around a 7% decrease in yields for these four major crops
cues.zh: 我们知道，全球平均气温每升高 1 摄氏度，这四种主要作物的产量就会下降约 7%，

cues.en: that essentially provide 60% of global calories.
cues.zh: 它们提供了全球 60% 的热量。

cues.en: But these are global averages, and we know that single events can have much, much bigger impacts, and we've seen that play out, including in the previous El Niño cycle.
cues.zh: 但这些只是全球平均值。我们知道，单个事件可能造成大得多的影响；此前的厄尔尼诺周期就体现了这一点。

cues.en: Well, on that, scientists are predicting a super El Niño event, that hot event in the early part of next year.
cues.zh: 关于这一点，科学家预测明年年初将出现一次超级厄尔尼诺事件，也就是那场高温事件。

cues.en: Is that going to, how is that going to exacerbate what we're already experiencing?
cues.zh: 这会如何加剧我们已经面临的问题？

cues.en: Well, it's just going to magnify what we're already experiencing. We don't know exactly what El Niño holds in store for us this time around.
cues.zh: 它只会放大我们已经经历的情况。我们并不知道这一次厄尔尼诺究竟会带来什么。

cues.en: Previous El Niños are not necessarily a perfect prediction of the current ones,
cues.zh: 此前的厄尔尼诺不一定能完美预测当前这一次，

cues.en: but we've already seen, as you say, that this is going to be a strong one because of the ocean temperatures.
cues.zh: 但正如你所说，我们已经看到，由于海洋温度，这次将会很强。

cues.en: What we saw last time, the last cycle of El Niño, was extraordinary impacts.
cues.zh: 上一次、也就是上一轮厄尔尼诺带来的影响非常惊人。

cues.en: I mean, you take a country like Morocco:
cues.zh: 我的意思是，以摩洛哥这样的国家为例：

cues.en: In the last cycle, you saw extreme drought, extreme heat that led to over 40% drop in cereal yields and a complete failure, I guess, of the olive and citrus production.
cues.zh: 上一轮厄尔尼诺期间，极端干旱和高温导致谷物产量下降超过 40%，橄榄和柑橘产量也几乎完全失败。

cues.en: We saw cereal prices and yields drop in South Africa, potato in India, fruit and vegetables in Mexico, rice in Indonesia.
cues.zh: 我们看到南非的谷物价格和产量下降，印度的马铃薯、墨西哥的水果和蔬菜、印度尼西亚的水稻也受到影响。

cues.en: The list goes on and on, and I guess that's what's in store.
cues.zh: 这样的例子不胜枚举，我想这就是未来可能发生的情况。

cues.en: What's your advice then? What's the priority here in order to build a resilient food system?
cues.zh: 那么你的建议是什么？要建立有韧性的粮食系统，当前的重点是什么？

cues.en: Is it crop rotation? Is it completely revisiting the types of foodstuffs that we will be consuming going forward?
cues.zh: 是轮作吗？还是要彻底重新考虑我们今后将食用的食物种类？

cues.en: Absolutely, you've named some of the solutions. I mean, first and foremost is early warning.
cues.zh: 当然，你提到了一些解决方案。我的意思是，最重要的是预警。

cues.en: Our farmers have to know what's around the corner to help them with their planning, so that they know what to plant, when to plant it, what to store, how to store fodder and water,
cues.zh: 我们的农民必须知道即将发生什么，以便规划：种什么、什么时候种、储存什么，以及如何储存饲料和水，

cues.en: choose the right kind of drought- and heat-tolerant seeds and breeds.
cues.zh: 并选择合适的耐旱耐热种子和品种。

cues.en: All of these are going to be about building resilience.
cues.zh: 这一切都是为了建立韧性。

cues.en: We have to invest more in these kinds of practical solutions that save water, that help to maintain moisture in our soil.
cues.zh: 我们必须更多投资于节水、帮助保持土壤水分的实用方案。

cues.en: So really, it's so much about anticipatory action, so much about early warning to prevent the worst of what El Niño could bring.
cues.zh: 所以，关键在于预先采取行动、加强预警，防止厄尔尼诺可能带来的最坏后果。

cues.en: Kaveh Zahedi.
cues.zh: 卡韦·扎赫迪。

cues.en: Back in December last year, Australia passed a law banning social media for many teenagers. It was a first, and since then, other countries have followed suit.
cues.zh: 去年 12 月，澳大利亚通过法律，禁止许多青少年使用社交媒体。这是首例，此后其他国家也纷纷效仿。

cues.en: Now, representatives of various tech companies have been giving evidence about the ban to an Australian parliamentary inquiry.
cues.zh: 如今，各家科技公司的代表正就这项禁令向澳大利亚议会调查委员会作证。

cues.en: So what's come out of that? I asked our correspondent in Sydney, Katie Watson.
cues.zh: 那么调查有什么结果？我询问了驻悉尼记者凯蒂·沃森。

cues.en: There have been a mixture of families whose children have died, have faced bullying from social media, as well as representatives of the platforms,
cues.zh: 出席者包括孩子死亡或遭受社交媒体霸凌的家庭，以及各平台的代表，

cues.en: regulators, government. They've been talking to a parliamentary inquiry about the social media ban and the changes that are going on here in Australia.
cues.zh: 还有监管机构和政府。他们向议会调查委员会介绍社交媒体禁令，以及澳大利亚正在发生的变化。

cues.en: And what has come out so far? What has been the impact of the ban?
cues.zh: 到目前为止有什么结果？这项禁令产生了什么影响？

cues.en: Well, I mean, if you were to ask the average teenager that I've done in the last few months, they would say nothing's happened.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，如果你问问我过去几个月采访的普通青少年，他们会说什么也没发生。

cues.en: I mean, it's been going for eight months, and certainly in March, the eSafety Commissioner said that it was concerned platforms weren't doing enough to uphold the ban.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，禁令已经实施八个月了。尤其是在 3 月，电子安全专员表示，担心各平台没有采取足够措施来执行禁令。

cues.en: There are definitely statistics, I mean government figures, other independent studies, they've shown that about eight in ten under-16s are still on social media.
cues.zh: 当然有统计数据，我是说政府数据和其他独立研究都显示，大约十名未满 16 岁者中有八人仍在使用社交媒体。

cues.en: That was in the first three months. So clearly, if you're looking at kind of numbers who've been pushed off platforms, not much.
cues.zh: 这是实施后的头三个月的数据。所以显然，如果看有多少人被平台清除，人数并不多。

cues.en: However, the government kind of talks about this as much more of a long-term issue trying to kind of change the way people think about online safety.
cues.zh: 不过，政府更倾向于把这看作一个长期问题，试图改变人们对网络安全的看法。

cues.en: But because of this discussion about whether it's working or not, the government has doubled the maximum fines for not complying.
cues.zh: 但由于人们讨论禁令是否有效，政府已将违规的最高罚款提高一倍。

cues.en: So they initially were facing, they'd face fines, and it's not the children, it's not the parents, it's very much the platforms.
cues.zh: 起初，面临罚款的——他们会面临罚款的——不是孩子，也不是父母，而主要是各个平台。

cues.en: Now, they can face up to about 70 million US dollars if they're found not to be taking steps to kick under-16s off.
cues.zh: 如今，如果被认定没有采取措施让未满 16 岁者退出平台，平台可能面临最高约 7,000 万美元罚款。

cues.en: So this hearing was kind of going through talking to all of the players in this ban.
cues.zh: 所以，这次听证会是在逐一询问这项禁令涉及的各方。

cues.en: And what are the tech companies saying about all this? Because from what I've read, they have closed down a number of accounts. Do they say they're on top of this?
cues.zh: 科技公司对此怎么说？因为据我所知，它们已经关闭了一些账户。它们是否表示已经掌控了局面？

cues.en: Yeah, so Meta kind of preempted this hearing and earlier this week they put out some numbers.
cues.zh: 是的，Meta 某种程度上提前回应了这次听证会，并在本周早些时候公布了一些数字。

cues.en: They said there's a total of 750,000 accounts that have been closed since the ban.
cues.zh: Meta 称，禁令实施以来总共有 750,000 个账户被关闭。

cues.en: They already announced around 500,000 had been closed between Instagram and Facebook, like in the run-up to the ban,
cues.zh: 它们此前已经宣布，在禁令实施前后，Instagram 和 Facebook 上约有 500,000 个账户被关闭，

cues.en: So it's an extra 250,000 accounts that have been closed up until now.
cues.zh: 所以截至目前又多关闭了 250,000 个账户。

cues.en: Now they say they're still monitoring it. Every time somebody's flagged as being under 16, then they kick those people off.
cues.zh: Meta 现在称仍在持续监控。每当有人被标记为未满 16 岁，他们就会将其移除。

cues.en: But they have also made clear that they don't agree with this ban and the way it works.
cues.zh: 但他们也明确表示，不赞成这项禁令及其实施方式。

cues.en: Clearly, there's a lot of court cases that they're facing. I spoke to the commissioner herself, who said
cues.zh: 显然，他们面临许多诉讼。我采访了专员本人，她说，

cues.en: that it's like she's dealing with kind of 10 different investigations on each different platform, looking at the numbers, looking at what they're doing.
cues.zh: 她仿佛要处理每个平台的十项不同调查，查看相关数字和平台的所作所为。

cues.en: But fining a company will take probably a court battle and then, you know, some. So it's taking a long time to actually kind of see whether
cues.zh: 但给一家公司罚款可能要经过法庭交锋，然后还要——你知道——一些程序。所以，要真正看出

cues.en: this ban and these fines will actually work.
cues.zh: 这项禁令和这些罚款是否有效，需要很长时间。

cues.en: Katie Watson in Sydney.
cues.zh: 凯蒂·沃森在悉尼报道。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast... Now we can start to discover who has put it over there.
cues.zh: 本期播客稍后还将报道……现在我们可以开始查明是谁把它放在那里。

cues.en: Is there a criminal side on that gold?
cues.zh: 那批黄金是否涉及犯罪？

cues.en: The mystery of the multi-million dollar gold stash discovered in a house renovation.
cues.zh: 房屋翻修时发现价值数百万美元黄金藏品的谜团。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: The civil war in Sudan has been described as one of the worst humanitarian crises in the world.
cues.zh: 苏丹内战被称为世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。

cues.en: The city of El Obeid has become the focal point in the conflict.
cues.zh: 奥贝德市已成为冲突的焦点。

cues.en: With the rebel Rapid Support Forces pounding the city with drones as they try to take control from government forces.
cues.zh: 叛军快速支援部队用无人机猛烈轰炸该市，试图从政府军手中夺取控制权。

cues.en: The two groups have been fighting since April 2023.
cues.zh: 双方自 2023 年 4 月以来一直在交战。

cues.en: Thousands of children are among those fleeing to El Obeid to escape violence in other parts of the country, but conditions in the city are desperate.
cues.zh: 逃往奥贝德、躲避该国其他地区暴力的人中有数千名儿童，但这座城市的状况十分危急。

cues.en: Francesco Lanino is the Deputy Country Director for Save the Children in Sudan.
cues.zh: 弗朗切斯科·拉尼诺是救助儿童会驻苏丹副国别主任。

cues.en: In the last few months, around 40,000 displaced children are arriving in Obeid, and many of them arrive with their family
cues.zh: 过去几个月，约有 40,000 名流离失所儿童抵达奥贝德，其中许多孩子和家人一起到来，

cues.en: and with almost nothing. And the first thing they are looking for is food, because they left with nothing.
cues.zh: 几乎一无所有。他们首先寻找的是食物，因为离开时什么也没带。

cues.en: So, you know, children and their families, they leave their places and they walk for days looking for a safe place to go and escaping the violence.
cues.zh: 所以，孩子和家人离开自己的家园，徒步数日寻找安全的去处，逃避暴力。

cues.en: But the city itself is now also hard to reach, and supplies cannot really reach El Obeid in time, and the food prices have increased dramatically in the last few months.
cues.zh: 但如今这座城市本身也很难抵达，物资无法及时送到奥贝德，过去几个月食品价格大幅上涨。

cues.en: So we have a situation in which children already arrive with high malnutrition, and now, even worse, there is also cholera outbreak.
cues.zh: 因此，孩子们抵达时已经严重营养不良，而现在情况更糟，又出现了霍乱疫情。

cues.en: There is a water scarcity and very bad water quality, because all these drone attacks are affecting also, you know, all the water stations and wells.
cues.zh: 这里还缺水，水质非常差，因为所有这些无人机袭击也影响了供水站和水井。

cues.en: As Save the Children, now we have an office in El Obeid, and we managed to bring supplies into the city,
cues.zh: 救助儿童会目前在奥贝德设有办事处，我们设法把物资运进了这座城市，

cues.en: but there's only few routes available. The challenge we are facing now, with all this global crisis, is that the price for fuel has increased dramatically.
cues.zh: 但目前只有少数几条路线可用。全球危机之下，我们现在面临的挑战是燃料价格大幅上涨。

cues.en: And then, according to several data, you know, half of Sudanese children witnesses the loss of one of their family members,
cues.zh: 此外，根据多项数据，约一半苏丹儿童目睹了家人中的一人失去生命，

cues.en: have been out of schools for years, and also have been displaced so many times all around the country.
cues.zh: 他们多年无法上学，也在全国各地一次又一次流离失所。

cues.en: When I was in Darfur just a few weeks ago, one of the things that I could witness was
cues.zh: 几周前我在达尔富尔时，亲眼见到的一件事是，

cues.en: the difficulties for children to play, because they were something they were not used to.
cues.zh: 孩子们难以玩耍，因为这对他们来说是从未习惯的事情。

cues.en: So in a context in which you spend the majority of the day moving from one place to another one,
cues.zh: 在这样的环境下，人们一天大部分时间都在从一个地方迁往另一个地方，

cues.en: just fetching water or looking for food, there is no time for being a child.
cues.zh: 只顾取水或寻找食物，根本没有时间做一个孩子。

cues.en: Francesco Lanino speaking to us from Port Sudan.
cues.zh: 弗朗切斯科·拉尼诺从苏丹港接受我们的采访。

cues.en: Now, listeners are unlikely ever to have heard an odder snapshot of the shape of British politics than a parliamentary by-election
cues.zh: 听众可能从未听过比这更古怪的英国政治写照：一场议会补选

cues.en: which has been held in the east of England in the seaside town of Clacton.
cues.zh: 在英格兰东部海滨小镇克拉克顿举行。

cues.en: With a list of candidates literally as long as your arm, there were 34 of them,
cues.zh: 候选人名单长得几乎像你的手臂一样，总共有34人，

cues.en: It's been won by the right-wing Reform UK leader, Nigel Farage, who triggered the poll in the first place.
cues.zh: 最终由右翼政党改革英国党领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇获胜；正是他最初触发了这场补选。

cues.en: He'd resigned as MP for Clacton in response to an investigation into his finances.
cues.zh: 他因针对其财务状况的调查而辞去克拉克顿议员职务。

cues.en: He received over 22,000 votes, even more than when he first won the seat two years ago.
cues.zh: 他获得了超过2.2万张选票，比两年前首次赢得这个席位时还多。

cues.en: On the hottest day of the year, in the middle of August, in holiday season, we have secured far more votes than we got in the general election of 2024!
cues.zh: 在一年中最热的一天、八月中旬的假期季，我们获得的选票远多于2024年大选时的票数！

cues.en: But all of Reform's main political rivals boycotted the election.
cues.zh: 但改革英国党的主要政治对手都抵制了这场选举。

cues.en: So, Mr Farage's main challenger: Count Binface, a comedian dressed as a rubbish bin,
cues.zh: 所以，法拉奇的主要挑战者是“垃圾桶伯爵”：一名打扮成垃圾桶的喜剧演员，

cues.en: and a veteran of polls up and down the UK, including the Macclesfield by-election won by the now Prime Minister, Andy Burnham.
cues.zh: 也是英国各地选举的老面孔，包括现任首相安迪·伯恩汉赢得的梅克斯菲尔德补选。

cues.en: Mr Farage did not attend the count, citing security concerns, but Count Binface did.
cues.zh: 法拉奇以安全问题为由没有参加计票，但“垃圾桶伯爵”去了。

cues.en: To hear the verdict of the Clactonites was the least I could do. And why? Because I've had over
cues.zh: 来听取克拉克顿居民的裁决，是我至少能做的事。为什么？因为我获得了超过

cues.en: 9,000 votes, guys. Now, in Macclesfield, eight weeks ago, I got 95 votes. So against Nigel Farage, compared to Andy Burnham, I am 1,000 times more popular!
cues.zh: 9000张选票，各位。八周前在梅克斯菲尔德，我只得到95票。所以对阵奈杰尔·法拉奇、和安迪·伯恩汉相比，我受欢迎了一千倍！

cues.en: Extraordinarily, though, there is now a chance that voters will need to go to the polls again in Clacton in a few months' time.
cues.zh: 不过，令人惊讶的是，几个月后克拉克顿选民可能还需要再次投票。

cues.en: That's because moments after Mr Farage regained his seat, a paused parliamentary investigation
cues.zh: 因为法拉奇重新赢得席位后不久，一项暂停的议会调查

cues.en: into whether he should have declared a cash gift of $6.7 million or £5 million was restarted.
cues.zh: 调查他是否应该申报一笔670万美元、也就是500万英镑的现金赠礼，并已重新启动。

cues.en: If he's found to have broken the rules, he could then be suspended from Parliament for long enough to trigger, yes, another by-election.
cues.zh: 如果调查认定他违反了规定，他可能被议会停职足够长时间，从而触发——没错——另一场补选。

cues.en: Our UK political correspondent, Rob Watson, told me about this most colourful of by-elections.
cues.zh: 我们的英国政治记者罗布·沃森向我介绍了这场最为多彩的补选。

cues.en: Goodness, I'll try and make sense of it. I'm not sure how successful I'm going to be here by the sea and the sand in Clacton-on-Sea.
cues.zh: 天哪，我来试着理清这件事。我不确定在克拉克顿海边的阳光沙滩旁，自己能不能讲清楚。

cues.en: But I mean, certainly of all the by-elections I've covered on and off the last, I don't know, 40 years, it's definitely one of the oddest, because, you know, essentially
cues.zh: 不过，当然，在过去——我也不知道——40年间我断断续续报道过的所有补选中，这绝对是最古怪的一场，因为基本上，

cues.en: you had Nigel Farage up against a man with a bin on his head who claims in a comedic way to be a traveller from another planet
cues.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇面对的是一个头戴垃圾桶、以喜剧方式自称来自另一颗星球的男子，

cues.en: and that he did remarkably well. And I don't think there's ever been a by-election where there were 34 candidates, so pretty extraordinary stuff.
cues.zh: 而他表现得非常出色。我不认为过去有哪场补选有34名候选人，确实非同寻常。

cues.en: Yet 9,000 votes he got, that's not an insignificant amount of people. But let's get on to this parliamentary inquiry that's restarting. What's going on with that, Rob?
cues.zh: 不过，他拿到9000票，这可不是个小数目。但我们来谈谈重新启动的议会调查。罗布，这究竟是怎么回事？

cues.en: Well, the Commissioner for Parliamentary Standards has made it clear that that is now resuming now that Nigel Farage is becoming an MP again.
cues.zh: 议会标准专员已经明确表示，随着奈杰尔·法拉奇再次成为议员，调查现已恢复。

cues.en: So if the hope of Reform and its leader Nigel Farage had been that this by-election would sort of kill all that off, that is not happening.
cues.zh: 所以，如果改革英国党及其领袖奈杰尔·法拉奇曾希望这场补选能让一切就此结束，那么他们没有如愿。

cues.en: And just to remind everyone briefly of the sort of detail of it all, essentially
cues.zh: 简要提醒大家其中的细节，基本上，

cues.en: Nigel Farage was given a gift of £5 million from a cryptocurrency billionaire based in Thailand before the 2024 general election.
cues.zh: 2024年大选前，奈杰尔·法拉奇从一名居住在泰国的加密货币亿万富翁那里得到了一笔500万英镑的赠礼。

cues.en: Now the rules state that even if you're not yet an MP, you should declare any gifts, certainly ones as big as that.
cues.zh: 规定要求，即使你还不是议员，也应申报任何赠礼，尤其是这样大额的赠礼。

cues.en: Now Nigel Farage said everything was all above board, that he hadn't done anything wrong, it was nothing to do with politics, but that now will be examined.
cues.zh: 奈杰尔·法拉奇说一切都合规，他没有做错任何事，这与政治无关；但这些说法现在将接受调查。

cues.en: What I can't tell you, Pete, is exactly how long that investigation will take or what it might come up with.
cues.zh: 皮特，我无法告诉你的是，这项调查究竟要持续多久，或会得出什么结果。

cues.en: But the importance of it is that one of the things that's really been knocking Reform back,
cues.zh: 但这件事的重要性在于，它是改革英国党受挫的原因之一，

cues.en: and it's important to remember that it was leading in the polls in spring, its sort of populist right-wing message resonating with many...
cues.zh: 要知道，该党春季时还在民调中领先，其民粹右翼信息曾引起许多人共鸣……

cues.en: But one of the things which really seems to have sort of eaten into that popularity is concerns about Nigel Farage and indeed the party's finances more widely.
cues.zh: 但这种支持度受到侵蚀的一个重要原因，似乎正是人们对奈杰尔·法拉奇以及该党整体财务状况的担忧。

cues.en: And what, if anything, then, can that tell us about the state of British politics on a national level? Because as you say, many had tipped Mr Farage
cues.zh: 那么，这件事究竟能告诉我们英国全国政治处于什么状态？正如你所说，许多人曾看好法拉奇

cues.en: to be the next Prime Minister following Andy Burnham, but his support had taken a bit of a hit. But can we tell anything by his electoral success in the last 24 hours?
cues.zh: 成为安迪·伯恩汉之后的下一任首相，但他的支持度已经受到一些打击。不过，我们能从他过去24小时的选举胜利中看出什么吗？

cues.en: Well, it was probably a bit hasty to say he was going to become Prime Minister in a few years' time, and one would want to be cautious about reading too much from this by-election.
cues.zh: 说他几年后会成为首相可能有些草率，人们应谨慎解读这场补选，不能从中推断太多。

cues.en: But I think you can say the following about British politics and where all this leaves us.
cues.zh: 但我认为，可以这样看英国政治以及这一切将我们带向何方。

cues.en: It tells you that things are very fluid and that there are lots of big questions out there we can't answer.
cues.zh: 这说明局势变化很快，还有许多重大问题无法回答。

cues.en: First one is: can Nigel Farage and Reform bounce back?
cues.zh: 第一个问题：奈杰尔·法拉奇和改革英国党能否反弹？

cues.en: Number two: can Andy Burnham, the sort of newish leader of the Labour Party and Prime Minister, can he maintain his bounce?
cues.zh: 第二个问题：作为相对新任的工党领袖和首相，安迪·伯恩汉能否保持反弹势头？

cues.en: And can the Conservatives somehow claw back some of their right-of-centre votes from Reform? Rob Watson.
cues.zh: 保守党能否设法从改革英国党手中夺回一部分中右选票？罗布·沃森报道。

cues.en: To Spain, where the government has announced it's extending the life of the country's biggest nuclear plant.
cues.zh: 前往西班牙：政府宣布延长该国最大核电站的运行寿命。

cues.en: The Almaraz plant was due to be decommissioned in two years' time, but will now remain open until 2030,
cues.zh: 阿尔马拉斯核电站原计划两年后退役，但现在将继续运行至2030年，

cues.en: Despite previous plans to close all nuclear reactors by 2035 and focus on renewables.
cues.zh: 尽管此前计划在2035年前关闭所有核反应堆并转向可再生能源。

cues.en: Our global affairs reporter, Sebastian Usher, told me more.
cues.zh: 我们的国际事务记者塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍介绍了更多情况。

cues.en: It's the biggest nuclear power reactor in Spain. It provides about 7% of the electricity output, the power output, so it's absolutely key up until now in terms of the supply.
cues.zh: 这是西班牙最大的核电反应堆，约占全国电力产出的7%，所以到目前为止，它对电力供应至关重要。

cues.en: I mean, this goes back a little while. This commitment by the Spanish government, this left-leaning Spanish government, to switch by 2035
cues.zh: 这项承诺由来已久：这个偏左的西班牙政府计划在2035年前转向

cues.en: to close down all the power stations so they can go to renewables and really to force that change through by doing this.
cues.zh: 关闭所有发电站、转向可再生能源，并通过这样做推动这一转变。

cues.en: Intervening in between, of course, have been several things: the war in Ukraine first and the war in Iran, both of which have severely disrupted
cues.zh: 当然，期间发生了几件事：先是乌克兰战争，之后是伊朗战争；两者都严重扰乱了

cues.en: energy supplies and really putting more and more of an emphasis
cues.zh: 能源供应，也越来越突显

cues.en: It's not just Spain, but other European countries feeling this, of providing their own source of power, their own sources of energy, rather than importing it.
cues.zh: 不仅西班牙，其他欧洲国家也感受到这种压力：它们需要提供自己的电力和能源来源，而不是依赖进口。

cues.en: So that's been one issue.
cues.zh: 这是一个问题。

cues.en: And then last year, I don't know if people remember, but there was this massive outage of power across the Iberian Peninsula, both Spain and Portugal,
cues.zh: 去年，大家不知道是否还记得，西班牙和葡萄牙所在的伊比利亚半岛曾发生大规模停电，

cues.en: And that again led to a rethinking.
cues.zh: 这再次促使人们重新思考。

cues.en: So what the Spanish government said was that if the owners of these nuclear power reactors had a good case to make for keeping them open a bit longer, then they would consider it.
cues.zh: 所以西班牙政府说，如果这些核反应堆的所有者能提出充分理由，希望让它们多运行一段时间，政府会予以考虑。

cues.en: So what's happened is that they've done that. They've made the case, the Spanish government has acceded to that to an extent,
cues.zh: 结果就是他们确实提出了理由。西班牙政府在一定程度上同意了，

cues.en: and the organization that assesses the safety of the nuclear power reactors has also given it a clean bill of health.
cues.zh: 而负责评估核反应堆安全性的机构也认为它状况良好。

cues.en: So it's an extension by two years at the moment. It does raise, obviously, the possibility of this happening
cues.zh: 所以目前是延长两年。显然，这也带来了这种情况发生的可能性，

cues.en: with other reactors where, again, those companies have also suggested that they'll be making the same kind of case.
cues.zh: 即其他反应堆也可能如此，因为那些公司也表示会提出类似理由。

cues.en: Sebastian Usher.
cues.zh: 塞巴斯蒂安·厄舍报道。

cues.en: Police in Belgium are investigating after construction workers discovered a cache of gold treasure behind a wall in a house they were renovating.
cues.zh: 比利时警方正在调查：建筑工人在翻修一栋房屋时，在墙后发现了一批黄金宝藏。

cues.en: Gold bars and coins worth more than $10 million were found in a chest by workers in a town in Eastern Flanders.
cues.zh: 工人在东佛兰德斯一座城镇的箱子里发现了价值超过1000万美元的金条和金币。

cues.en: Alice Addeley reports.
cues.zh: 艾丽丝·阿德利报道。

cues.en: Imagine the surprise: you're carrying out a house renovation, and after knocking down a wall, you discover a chest containing millions of dollars worth of gold.
cues.zh: 想象一下这种惊喜：你正在翻修房屋，推倒一面墙后，发现一个装着价值数百万美元黄金的箱子。

cues.en: That's what happened in the small Flemish city of Dendermonde.
cues.zh: 这就发生在佛兰德斯小城登德尔蒙德。

cues.en: In the chest were at least 4,000 gold coins and more than 40 gold bars, dating from the 1950s and '60s.
cues.zh: 箱子里至少有4000枚金币和超过40根金条，可追溯到20世纪50年代和60年代。

cues.en: Patrick Vays is the Chief of Police for Dendermonde.
cues.zh: 帕特里克·韦斯是登德尔蒙德警察局长。

cues.en: We are certain that it has nothing to do with the Second World War, because it's from the '50s or the '60s, the gold bars.
cues.zh: 我们确定这与第二次世界大战无关，因为这些金条来自五六十年代。

cues.en: But we don't have any other clue why it was covered in the ground over there.
cues.zh: 但我们没有其他线索，不知道它为什么被埋在那里。

cues.en: The house used to belong to a local brewer and now belongs to a charity, so the police are looking into who put the gold there and whether there was any crime involved.
cues.zh: 这栋房子曾属于当地一名酿酒商，如今归一家慈善机构所有，因此警方正在调查是谁把黄金放在那里，以及是否涉及犯罪。

cues.en: Now it's very safe in a central safe of the federal government, and now we can start to discover who has put it over there.
cues.zh: 现在黄金被安全地存放在联邦政府的中央金库里，我们可以开始查明是谁把它放在那里。

cues.en: Is there a criminal side on that gold, or it's just someone who has put it away for later, yeah?
cues.zh: 那批黄金是否涉及犯罪，还是有人只是把它藏起来留待日后使用？

cues.en: Yeah. The police are warning prospectors to stay away from the house where it was discovered.
cues.zh: 是的。警方警告寻宝者远离发现黄金的那栋房屋。

cues.en: Don't come to the works over there. It's very dangerous. There are workers. You can't see anything. Everything is gone.
cues.zh: 不要到那里的施工现场来。那里非常危险，有工人在工作。你什么也看不到，一切都已经清理完毕。

cues.en: It's not a touristic place. It's too dangerous to discover something yourself.
cues.zh: 那不是旅游景点，自己去寻宝太危险。

cues.en: The building belongs to a homeless charity, CAW, and its Director General, Geert Hillaert, said he was surprised and amazed by the discovery.
cues.zh: 这栋建筑属于无家可归者慈善机构CAW，其总干事赫特·希勒特说，他对这一发现既惊讶又震撼。

cues.en: We certainly aren't counting our chickens before they hatch at the moment, nor are we thinking about what we're going to do with it yet.
cues.zh: 目前我们当然不会过早盘算结果，也还没考虑要如何处理这笔财富。

cues.en: Right now, we're mostly still surfing the wave of amazement,
cues.zh: 现在，我们主要还沉浸在惊讶之中，

cues.en: and we're also especially glad that it's safe.
cues.zh: 也特别庆幸它得到了安全保管。

cues.en: If they are found to be the legal owners, they hope to use the money to help local people who are down on their luck.
cues.zh: 如果他们被认定为合法所有者，希望用这笔钱帮助当地处境困难的人。

cues.en: Alice Addeley reporting.
cues.zh: 艾丽丝·阿德利报道。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now. If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 我们目前的节目就到这里。如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at @BBCWorldService, use the hashtag #GlobalNewsPod.
cues.zh: 你也可以在X上通过@BBCWorldService找到我们，或使用话题标签#GlobalNewsPod。

cues.en: And don't forget our sister podcast, The Global Story, which goes in-depth and beyond the headlines on one big story.
cues.zh: 别忘了我们的姊妹播客《全球故事》，它会围绕一个重大故事深入探究，超越新闻标题。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Kai Perry,
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由凯·佩里混音，

cues.en: and the producers were Chaz Geiger and Guy Pitt. The editor is Karen Martin.
cues.zh: 制作人是查兹·盖格和盖伊·皮特。编辑是凯伦·马丁。

cues.en: I am Pete Ross. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 我是皮特·罗斯。下次再见。
